Gujarat HC: Sharing exam photos on WhatsApp not IT Act privacy violation

The Gujarat High Court has ruled that taking and sharing photos of an exam question paper via WhatsApp does not constitute a privacy violation under Section 66E of the Information Technology Act. The court clarified that this section pertains to the violation of a person's privacy, not the act of sharing exam material. This decision could impact how such cases are treated under the IT Act.
